name: Amargasuchus
isnote: PBDB lists Peirosauridae, but the original assignment was to the Trematochampsidae (Chiappe 1988) and English Wikipedia calls it a notosuchian; check.
sum: Amargasuchus is a notosuchian crocodylomorph known from a partial maxilla from the La Amarga Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A partial maxilla of small size (English Wikipedia).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Chiappe 1988
